capture: road-563-custom-lookup-insert
started: 2026-11-25T06:23:19Z
finished: 2026-11-25T06:28:08Z
sf: @salesforce/cli/2.159.7
org: Developer edition scratch org from a configured Dev Hub, deleted after capture
mode: live Salesforce
apis: 62.0, 67.0
routes: executeAnonymous and @IsTest
scenarios: 6 in each cell, 24 observations

Deployed the synthetic project at API 62.0 and assigned LookupFinchCapture
to the scratch runner so executeAnonymous could access both lookup fields.
Re-deployed the owned test class at API 67.0. Queried ApexClass.ApiVersion
through the Tooling API after each deploy and confirmed 62.0 and 67.0.
Invoked sf apex run and sf apex run test with the corresponding --api-version.
The @IsTest method reports observations through an intentional assertion.
Anonymous Apex rolls back its records before the debug observation.
In the observations, <target15> stands for the first 15 characters of
the absent target ID. Successful rows record the presence of assigned IDs.

The partial insert sends five rows in one batch. Its results record success,
presence of result ID, presence of input ID and error count. A failure also
records status code, fields and message. The scalar insert reports whether
it threw DmlException, presence of input ID, error count, failing row index,
status code, fields and message.

NEIGHBOR PROBES
- Same-object self lookup uses the existing self_lookup_insert native fixture.
- Wrong-prefix IDs, malformed local placeholders, required or master-detail
  lookups, polymorphic references, lookup references to User, and other lookup
  delete policies were outside this capture and retain main behavior.
- Update, upsert, workflow and direct Flow create or field-update routes were
  outside this capture and retain main behavior.
